messages:
Alex: Heads up — invoices showing duplicated token charges for ~10 customers after the routing fallback landed this morning. Suspect duplicate billing events when request is retried/routed to fallback.
Maria: Is this happening for streaming only or regular complete calls too?
Alex: Mostly streaming and long-gen requests where the edge times out and we fallback to cheaper model. Both original + fallback produce billing events.
Sam: Can you paste sample events?
Alex: Sure — two events for same session.
```
{"event_type":"billing_token","request_id":"req_01F..","client_request_id":"cr_42","route":"model-A","tokens":120}
{"event_type":"billing_token","request_id":"req_01F..","client_request_id":"cr_42","route":"model-B-fallback","tokens":118}
```
Lee: Looks like request_id is preserved but our pipeline key is (request_id, route) which makes them distinct. No idempotency across route changes.
Maria: We do emit `client_request_id` from the SDK but the edge proxy isn't passing it through on the timeout path right now.
Sam: Two quick options: 1) add an idempotency key that persists across retries (e.g., `request_guid` set at the first hop) and dedupe in the biller; or 2) dedupe in downstream metering by (client_request_id, time-window).
Alex: Prefer (1). Put the canonical request_guid on the envelope so any retry retains it. fallback routing should copy original guid.
Lee: Agree. Also add `attempt_index` and `original_route` fields so we can distinguish legitimate replays vs duplicates.
Maria: If we add dedupe, dashboard UX needs to show "raw tokens" vs "billing tokens after dedupe" — customers will ask why numbers changed after the fix.
Sam: We should surface a delta column on the billing export and a toggle in Console's Invoice view (show deduped events on/off).
Alex: Rollout plan: wire the guid through edge proxy + proxy test canary in us-west for 24h, enable pipeline dedupe but keep in shadow mode (tag events as dedup_candidate) for another 48h, then flip to active.
Lee: Also add a 5s dedupe window as a safety net for double-emits from the same hop. But rely primarily on request_guid idempotency.
Maria: QA checklist: replay recorded faulty trace through staging with request_guid preserved, ensure only first event counted; confirm invoice export includes dedupe flags; update alerting thresholds (billing spike alert should ignore shadowed dedupes).
opsbot: Deployment scheduled: canary/edge-proxy v2.14 -> us-west at 2024-06-28T18:00Z :package: :rocket:
metering-bot: New field proposal created: metering.schema.v2 (fields: request_guid, attempt_index, original_route, dedupe_flag). Tracking ticket #MET-724.
Sam: Note — we need to update SDK docs so users know `client_request_id` is respected but recommend using `request_guid` for multi-hop idempotency.
Alex: I'll open the SDK + proxy PRs and link MET-724. For now, flagging high priority — finance team already noticed invoices and asked for ETA. :eyes:
Maria: Thanks. If someone from billing wants to join quick sync in 15, ping here and we'll triage.
Sam: I'll be there.
Lee: Dropping a quick test plan in MET-724 after lunch. :+1:
thread_summary: Duplicate billing events after fallback routing; plan to add request_guid idempotency, attempt_index, and dashboard changes; canary rollout and metering schema v2 created.
